Why did Yashoda almost faint when Krishna opened his mouth? As the story goes, little Krishna was playing with his friends, when they came running. Mother! He's eating mud!
Yashoda grabbed him. Open your mouth, right now. Krishna shook his head. I didn't! Open it! So he opened his tiny mouth.
And inside, she saw the whole universe. Stars. Planets. Oceans. Mountains. The sun and the moon. And even herself, standing in Gokul, holding him. Wait, what happened next?

She almost fainted. So Krishna smiled, and made her forget everything. Because she didn't need God. She needed her little boy. That's why he lets us love him like a child. Comment Yashoda if this gave you chills.
